articles.title: Sam Bankman-Fried officially asks Trump for a presidential pardon
articles.snippet: The fallen crypto mogul serving a 25-year sentence filed a clemency petition, betting on Donald Trump's history of crypto pardons even though the president had told him not to count on one.

articles.title: Justin Sun’s HTX delists Trump family’s USD1 amid freeze fight
articles.snippet: HTX said World Liberty froze its addresses and has responded by delisting and suspending the platform’s token.

articles.title: FTX Founder Sam Bankman-Fried Has Formally Filed for a Pardon From President Trump
articles.snippet: President Trump previously ruled out a pardon for Sam Bankman-Fried—but the FTX founder has applied for one anyway.

articles.title: Bitcoin Has Dumped All of Its Gains Since Trump Was Reelected—And Then Some
articles.snippet: Bitcoin surged in the wake of President Trump's reelection, pushing to new highs deep into 2025. Now it's down more than 50% from that peak.
